command: set -e; python -c "import inspect, edullm_data, edullm_data.profiles.registry as R, edullm_data.publish as P; assert edullm_data.__version__=='0.9.1', 'WRONG IMAGE VERSION: '+edullm_data.__version__; assert 'hash_workers' in inspect.signature(P.publish).parameters, 'NO HASH WORKERS'; m=R.get_profile('pretrain-tokens/v1'); assert m.NAME=='pretrain-tokens/v1', m.NAME; print('PREFLIGHT_OK version='+edullm_data.__version__+' profile='+m.NAME)"; python -c "import boto3; s=boto3.client('s3'); [s.download_file('edullm-landing','_ingest/olmoe-mix-0824/DRIVERS/'+f,'/tmp/'+f) for f in ('olmoe_publish_driver.py','olmoe_final_50b.json','olmoe_final_100b.json','olmoe_0824_sizes.json')]; print('FETCH_OK')"; cd /tmp && echo PUBLISH_START release=${PUBLISH_RELEASE} mode=${PUBLISH_MODE}; set +e; python /tmp/olmoe_publish_driver.py --release ${PUBLISH_RELEASE} ${PUBLISH_MODE}; RC=$?; echo PUBLISH_DONE_RC=${RC}; exit ${RC}
